adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the sync path is gated by `userId` being truthy (`... && userId`), and the function signature is `userId: number | null`, with a comment “credential belongs to a user”. That means any credential refresh invoked with `userId` null (e.g., team-scoped creds) will always take the direct `refreshFunction()` path without any explicit signal—i.e., a silent fallback by design. The diff adds this new branching behavior across multiple integrations but introduces no tests exercising/locking in the user-vs-team behavior (or at least none are shown in the diff), which is a concrete review concern rather than a proven defect.
